title: Turkey Reuben Burgers
description: Ground turkey is combined with thousand island dressing, mozzarella cheese, and sauerkraut for this alternative to the classic Reuben sandwich. Serve with additional thousand island dressing for dipping.
ingredients: 0.5 teaspoon garlic salt, or to taste

steps.text: Combine ground turkey, garlic, thousand island dressing, and 1/2 cup Italian-style bread crumbs in a bowl. Do not overwork the mixture. Form into 4 patties; transfer to plate. Sprinkle with garlic salt and additional 1/4 cup bread crumbs; press crumbs into patties to adhere.

Heat olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Cook patties in oil until golden brown, 7 to 10 minutes per side. Transfer to plate; top each patty with a slice of mozzarella cheese.
Cook and stir onion rings in same skillet until tender, about 10 minutes, adding oil if necessary. Sprinkle with ground black pepper.
Heat a non-stick griddle to medium heat. Lightly butter bread slices on both sides; cook on each side until browned, about 2 minutes per side.
To assemble burgers, layer turkey and cheese patties, sauerkraut, and cooked onions between bread slices.

video.description: There’s no need to ever again face a boring turkey burger with this juicy, flavorful recipe in your repertoire! The secret to the great juiciness is to add Thousand Island dressing to the ground turkey. Also add some garlic and Italian-style bread crumbs for a moist meatloaf-like texture, and form into patties. Season with garlic salt and press more bread crumbs on the surface, then cook in olive oil. Place each patty between two slices of toasted whole grain bread and top with mozzarella, fried onions, black pepper and sauerkraut. Serve with a side of Thousand Island dressing for indulging your sandwich-dipping whims.
